fusions.name: Marsh Pounce
fusions.desc: Springs at a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 9 water damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Bullfrog Bark
fusions.desc: Barks a narrow blast of sound 5 tiles ahead that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Lily-Pad Vault
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you leap 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
